name: agentic/latest-posts
title: Latest Posts
description: Dynamic grid of Journal posts — a real WP_Query, not attribute-driven content, so it always reflects whatever the Journal actually has. Each card shows the featured image, date, title, excerpt, and a Read More link. Renders nothing if there are no published posts. With `relatedToCurrent` set, queries posts sharing a category with the post currently being viewed (excluding it) instead of the site's latest — used as the 'Related Posts' section on single.html — and backfills with the latest posts if too few share a category, so the grid never looks sparse.
